documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in manufacturing. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing Cedar Systems user in manufacturing who is experiencing workflow disruption due to a configuration change. They have explicitly stated that this is a support incident and requested that support be involved before any discussion of expansion. The current stage is 'customer' with verified consent and ownership, but the issue is not yet resolved.

claims.quote: Please get support involved before discussing expansion.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your workflow has stopped after a configuration change and that this is a support incident. Our support team is available to assist with resolving this issue. Once the current workflow is stable, we can revisit any expansion opportunities.
questions: What specific configuration change caused the workflow disruption?
Have you already contacted Cedar Systems support for assistance with this issue?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change causing the disruption is not specified.
It is unclear whether the support team has already been contacted.
